passive.name: Standard Blocking Technique
passive.text: While Shielded, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.4/0.46/0.52/0.58/0.64**/s. The Anomaly Buildup of **EX Special Attacks**/**Assist Follow-Ups** increase by **36/40/45/50/55%**.

passive.name: Hot Spring Soup
passive.text: Reduces DMG taken by **7.5/8.5/9.5/10.5/12%**. When attacked, the equipper's Energy Generation Rate increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** for 12s. When the equipper switches off-field, this buff will be transferred to the new on-field character with its duration refreshed. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Pet the Bunny
passive.text: Increases Max HP by **8/9.2/10.4/11.6/12.8%**. Increases the equipper's ATK by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** when they are shielded.

passive.name: Starlight Knight Flying Kick
passive.text: Increases Max HP by **8/9/10/11/12.5%**. When attacked, the equipper's Impact is increased by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** for 12s.

skillPriority: Chain Attack > Special Attack > Assist > Basic Attack > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Lightning Strike
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks in front, dealing **Physical DMG** and **Electric DMG**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified
entries.text:
When **Resolve** is above or equal to 75%, hold Basic Attack to activate.
Consume 75% **Resolve** to launch consecutive attacks in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing **Electric DMG**.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the **Quick Assist** of the squad member positioned before Seth.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Evasion Maneuver
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Thunder Assault
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a Dodge to activate:
Charge forward with a shield attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Damage received during the move is decreased by 40%.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Retreat to Advance
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Unleash a quick downward slash on enemies in front, dealing **Electric DMG**.
After the move, hold EX Special Attack to chain into **EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage**, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Armed Support
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Unleash a quick downward slash on enemies in front, dealing **Electric DMG**.
After the move, hold EX Special Attack to chain into **EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage**, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Thundershield
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Upon activation, gain 25% **Resolve**.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of **Assist Points** when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Launch a forward thrust attack, followed by two horizontal slashes, dealing **Electric DMG**.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the **Quick Assist** of the squad member positioned before Seth.
After activating the move, hold EX Special Attack to transition to **EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage** and charge faster.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Launch two shield attacks forward, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes in front, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Hold EX Special Attackto charge the move, and Seth will dash forward, unleashing a series of powerful slashes, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Activating the move accumulates 75% **Resolve**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging this skill, and damage taken is reduced by 40%.
Seth is invulnerable during the consecutive slashes.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Final Judgment
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of slashes in front, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Activating the move accumulates 75% **Resolve**.
After the move, hold EX Special Attack to chain into **EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage**, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Justice Prevails
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Launch a series of upward attacks in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Activating the move accumulates 75% **Resolve**, and grants 3 additional Assist Points.
After the move, hold EX Special Attack to chain into **EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage**, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Protector
entries.text: When Seth uses **EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage**, he gains a **Shield of Firm Resolve** equal to **80%** of his initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When **Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified** or **Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling** triggers a **Quick Assist** or **Chain Attack**, causing another squad member to enter the field, that squad member gains a **Shield of Firm Resolve** equal to **80**% of Seth's initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a **Shield of Firm Resolve** increases Anomaly Proficiency by **100**.

entries.name: Additional Ability: High Spirit
entries.text:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Seth's **Chain Attack: Final Judgment** or Finishing Move during **Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified** hits an enemy, the target's Anomaly Buildup RES to all Attributes is reduced by 20%, lasting 20s.

entries.name: Heroism
entries.text:
The shield value provided by **Shield of Firm Resolve** and its maximum limit is increased by 30%.
When **Shield of Firm Resolve** ends, the Anomaly Proficiency increase provided by **Core Passive: Protector** lasts an additional 10s.

entries.name: Recklessness of Youth
entries.text:
Upon entering battle, Seth immediately gains 75% **Resolve**.
Hitting an enemy with **Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified** increases the move's accumulated **Electric Anomaly Buildup** by 35%.

entries.name: Slow Reflexes
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Core Aspiration
entries.text: The Daze caused by **Defensive Assist: Thundershield** is increased by 25%.

entries.name: Distant Admiration
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Idealist
entries.text: When Seth lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with **Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified**, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.
